roster_note: Granite retaining wall, flooded ground floors, mooring rings.
civic_program: a broad paved square terminating an axial boulevard
institutional frontages on at least two sides
a monument or fountain on the axis
trolleybus or tram catenary poles along the boulevard
an underpass or service stair below the square
standard lamp standards, bollards and notice boards
circulation: the boulevard axis is unobstructed to the terminating frontage
damage_constraints: a crater interrupts the square; the axis and the terminating frontage remain readable
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the square reads as designed around the axis, not as a gap between buildings
